options: defaults, except Markdown output for trafilatura; identical full supplied HTML; no preprocessing or source URL argument
selection: Manual review for article retention, structure and removal of surrounding page clutter. This is a comparison of one page, not a general quality ranking.

htomd.review: Preserves the full article body, headings, formatting, links and hero image; removes navigation and newsletter. Omits the article title and byline.

trafilatura.review: Preserves the full article body, headings and formatting; removes navigation and newsletter. Default options omit links, images, article title and byline.

html2text.review: Most compact remaining output; retains the article title and byline, but also navigation, newsletter and footer. Default wrapping splits some Markdown links.

markdownify.review: Retains article text, formatting and links, but also the document title, navigation, newsletter and footer.

html-to-markdown.review: Retains article text and page clutter, including embedded image data.

htmd-py.review: Retains article text and extensive page clutter, including embedded image data.
